prompt: Where are the samples being stored?
note: (B) 重複 store 且答時間；(C) Yes 回 WH 問句。

prompt: Where do I sign for the delivery?
choices: On the line at the bottom.
note: (B) 重複 delivery→delivered；(C) 答重量。

prompt: Where's Ms. Tanaka's new office?
note: ★ 間接回答：「還沒搬進去」等於「現在還沒有那個地點」。(C) 重複 office 而且有 She 混淆你。

prompt: Where should the extra tables go?
note: (B) 答數量；(C) 重複 table。

prompt: Where can I get this document notarized?
choices: There's a bank two blocks north.
note: 就算 notarized（公證）不認得，也要能靠 Where 判斷只有 (A) 在講地點。

prompt: When is the shipment due to arrive?
note: ★ 問未來卻答「已經到了」，是合理的糾正型回答。(B) 答地點。

prompt: When do you need my availability for next month?
choices: By the end of this week.
note: (B) 重複 availability→available，聽起來很順但答的是別的事。

prompt: When was the last safety inspection?
choices: Let me pull up the records.
note: ★「我查一下」是合法的迴避型答案，多益很常用來當正解。

prompt: When will you be back from the conference?
note: (B) 答地點；(C) 答的是過去，時態不符。

prompt: When are we switching to the new system?
note: Once... 用條件代替時間點，是 When 的高階答法。(C) Yes ＋ 重複 switch。

prompt: Who's handling the Kim account now?
choices: It went to the Chicago branch.
note: ★ Who 的答案可以是分公司或部門，不一定是人。(B) 重複 handle。

prompt: Who ordered all these boxes?
note: ★ 用反問回答問句是完全合法的正解，別因為它不是「答案」就排除。

prompt: Who should I contact about a refund?
note: (B) 重複 contact；(C) 答金額。

prompt: Who's the speaker at the luncheon?
note: 「還沒公布」是迴避型正解。(C) 重複 speaker→speaks。

prompt: What's the deadline for the grant application?
note: (B) 重複 application→applied。

prompt: What happened to the display window?
choices: At the front of the store.
note: What happened to...? 問的是「發生什麼事」。(B) 重複 display。

prompt: What's the room rate for a double?
note: ★「看情況」是常見正解。(B) 重複 room；(C) Yes 回 WH。

prompt: What do you need me to bring?
note: (B) 重複 bring→brought；(C) 答時間。

prompt: What's causing the delay in production?
note: 問原因。(B) 重複 delay；(C) 答地點。

prompt: Why did the vendor cancel?
note: (B) 答時間；(C) Yes ＋ 重複 cancel。

prompt: Why are you working this weekend?
note: 直接講原因、沒有 Because，是 Why 的常態。(C) 重複 work。

prompt: Why wasn't I copied on that email?
choices: Sorry, I'll resend it to you.
note: ★「道歉＋補救」是抱怨型問句的標準正解。(B) 把 copy 當「影印」來騙。

prompt: Why is the lobby closed off?
note: (B) 重複 closed→closes 且答時間。

prompt: How's the new software working out?
choices: We're still getting used to it.
note: How's...working out? 問的是「用起來如何」。(B) 答價錢。

prompt: How much did the repairs come to?
note: come to ＝ 總計為。(A) 沒給數字但確實回答了金額。

prompt: How do we get to the plant from here?
note: ★ 用「我給你地圖」代替講路線，是合法正解。(B) 重複 plant。

prompt: How many copies should I make?
choices: One for everyone on the list.
note: (A) 沒講數字但確實回答了數量。(B) 重複 copies→copier。

prompt: How was your flight?
note: 問感受不是問方式。(B) 答目的地；(C) 重複 flight→fly。

prompt: Are you free to review this now?
choices: Can it wait until after lunch?
note: ★ 用反問婉拒。(B) 把 free 當「免費」；(C) 重複 review。

prompt: Has anyone called the electrician?
choices: Miguel's on the phone with them.
note: ★ 間接回答：「Miguel 正在跟他們通話」＝ 有人打了。(B) 有 Yes 但答的是停電。

prompt: Do you take credit cards?
note: 用「只收現金」代替 No。(B)(C) 都把 take 換成別的意思。

prompt: Did you get my message about the venue change?
note: ★ 反問等於「我沒收到」。(B) 有 Yes 但重複 change 且意思不對。

prompt: Is the warehouse open on Saturdays?
note: 「只到中午」＝ 有開但有限制，比單純 Yes 更常當正解。

prompt: Have the new uniforms come in?
note: back-ordered（缺貨待補）＝ 還沒到。(B) 重複 uniform。

prompt: Should we wait for Ms. Okafor?
choices: She said to start without her.
note: 轉述第三人的話來回答，是常見正解形式。(B) 重複 wait。

prompt: My flight was cancelled.
note: ★ 對方說了壞消息，用關心的反問回應。(B) 重複 flight。

prompt: That printer's been making a strange noise.
note: (C) 跟 noise 有關聯所以危險——話題相關不等於回答。(B) 重複 print。

prompt: We got three more applications today.
note: 對數字做比較是自然的回應。(B) 重複 application→applied。

prompt: I'll be out of the office next Monday.
note: ★ 聽到別人要請假，主動提議幫忙。(B)(C) 各重複一個原句單字。

prompt: These figures don't add up.
note: add up ＝ 數字對得起來。(B) 把 add 拆開當「加」，是片語陷阱。

prompt: The elevator's out of service again.
choices: The stairs are just around the corner.
note: out of service ＝ 故障停用。(B) 把 service 當「服務」。

prompt: I've never used this model before.
choices: There's a manual in the drawer.
note: 對方說不會用，正解提供解法。(B)(C) 各重複一個原句單字。

prompt: You're presenting at the trade show, aren't you?
choices: Only if the samples arrive in time.
I presented her with an award.
note: ★ 用條件回答，不給是或否。(C) 用 present 的另一個意思（頒發）。

prompt: The invoice hasn't been paid yet, has it?
note: ★ 間接回答：「會計週二就寄出了」＝ 已經付了，糾正了對方的假設。

prompt: We should leave by six, shouldn't we?
note: ★ 講理由來支持對方的判斷。(B) 重複 leave；(C) 重複 six。

prompt: Would you rather meet in person or by video?
note: 選一個並附理由。(B) Yes 回選擇疑問句一定錯。

prompt: Do you want the report in print or as a PDF?
note: ★「都可以」型的正解。(B) Yes 回選擇疑問；(C) 重複 print。

prompt: Is Ms. Alvarez in sales or in marketing?
note: ★ 第三選項陷阱：兩個都不是。(B) Yes 回選擇疑問句。

prompt: Would you mind holding the door?
note: ★ Would you mind...? 答應時要用否定（Not at all／Of course not），中文直覺容易選錯。(B) 重複 hold。

prompt: Why don't we push the launch back a week?
choices: That gives us time to test.
note: Why don't we...? 是提議不是問原因，別去找理由。(B) 把 push 當「推」。
